bio.text: Jamaal Bailey has represented New York State Senate District 36 since taking office in 2017.
Ballotpedia lists him as the Democratic candidate for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election; the Democratic primary for the seat on June 23, 2026 was canceled.

Gotham Gazette reported in March 2017 that he grew up in Co-op City in the Bronx, is a University at Albany graduate, and had served as district leader for the 83rd Assembly District and as community relations director for Assembly Speaker Carl Heastie before running for the Senate.

sources.title: Adjusting to Albany: Senator Jamaal Bailey
